what_this_is: clips EA IRIS could not analyse on this build, and why. They have no report in results/baselines/iris/, so they have no IRIS candidate list, so eval/labeling/make_pool.py keeps them out of the pool.
how_to_count_the_pool: one report in results/baselines/iris/ per clip IRIS analysed, plus the failures here, is the whole pool. This file is rewritten by each run, so clips_attempted_in_this_run is that run and not the pool.
